# Sun Lines

> Sun Lines (Sun Lines Elite Service S.r.l.) is a passenger transport company based in Olbia, Sardinia, operating for over 60 years. It runs public bus lines in Gallura, the Airbus line 90 between Olbia airport, Sassari and Alghero airport, coach hire and private car transfers with driver (NCC), and a car and camper park next to Olbia Costa Smeralda airport.

Last updated: 2026-10-22. Website languages: Italian, with an English version at https://www.sunlines.it/en/. Contact: phone +39 0789 50885, email info@sunlines.it, support and invoice forms at https://www.sunlines.it/assistenza. WhatsApp +39 346 320 6740 is for coach hire and private transfer quotes and long-term or camper parking only; questions about timetables, tickets and luggage are answered at https://www.sunlines.it/domande-frequenti. Address: Via Pozzo 23, 07026 Olbia (SS), Italy.

## Services

- [Airbus Linea 90 – Olbia, Sassari, Alghero](https://www.sunlines.it/airbus-olbia-sassari-alghero): Direct bus between Olbia port (Isola Bianca), Olbia centre, Olbia Costa Smeralda airport, Sassari, Alghero Fertilia airport and Alghero centre. Airport to airport in under 2 hours. Runs 15 April to 18 October, including Sundays and holidays. Booking required: buy tickets online (https://sites.bigosolutions.it/sunlines/it) up to one hour before departure; on-board purchase costs €5 extra and a seat is not guaranteed. Tickets are not refundable or changeable. One standard bag (50x30x25 cm, max 20 kg) plus one small hand bag included.
- [Linee e orari (public bus lines)](https://www.sunlines.it/linee-e-orari): Line 20 Olbia – Porto Rotondo – Porto Cervo – Baja Sardinia – Cannigione – Isuledda (1 June to 30 September, daily). Line 30 Olbia – Tempio Pausania – Costa Paradiso – Castelsardo – Porto Torres (1 June to 30 September, daily). Line 50 Olbia – Priatu – Sant'Antonio di Gallura (all year, not on Sundays and holidays). Tickets on board (cash, card where available, with surcharge) or in the Around Sardinia app. No seat reservation. Two bags up to 50x30x25 cm and 20 kg free.
- [Noleggio autobus con conducente (coach hire)](https://www.sunlines.it/noleggio-autobus): Coaches with driver, 20 and 50 seats, for groups, excursions in Gallura, group airport transfers, school trips, weddings and corporate events anywhere in Sardinia. Free quote, reply within hours.
- [Transfer e NCC (private car with driver)](https://www.sunlines.it/transfer-ncc): Private transfers from and to Olbia port, Olbia Costa Smeralda airport, hotels and other destinations in Sardinia, on booking.
- [Parcheggio aeroporto Olbia (Promo Parking by Sunlines)](https://www.sunlines.it/parcheggio-aeroporto-olbia): Guarded, video-monitored car park a 3-minute walk from Olbia Costa Smeralda airport terminal, with direct pedestrian access. Daily rates via Parkingmycar, Parkos and Myparking; 6-month and annual plans via WhatsApp. Camper area with electricity, water and public toilet.
- [Abbonamenti studenti Linea 50](https://www.sunlines.it/abbonamenti-studenti): Discounted monthly or annual passes for students up to 27, requested online.

## Help

- [Domande frequenti (FAQ)](https://www.sunlines.it/domande-frequenti): Short answers on which line to take for each destination, Airbus booking, changes and refunds, luggage limits, bikes, children, pets, student passes, parking, lost property, invoices and complaints.
- [Assistenza e contatti](https://www.sunlines.it/assistenza): Support requests, complaints, invoice requests.
- [Chi siamo](https://www.sunlines.it/chi-siamo): Company history, founder Luca Cassitta, ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications.
- [Condizioni generali di trasporto](https://www.sunlines.it/condizioni-generali)
